munit:test.name: names-are-trimmed-and-capitalised-unicode-safely

munit:test.name: email-is-lower-cased-and-phone-is-compacted
munit:test.description: Email lower case; phone without spaces, dashes and brackets; absent or blank phone becomes null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import normaliseEmail, normalisePhone from dwl::PatientMapping output application/json --- { email: normaliseEmail("Ana.Kovac@Example.com"), phones: [ normalisePhone("+387 61 111-222"), normalisePhone("(065) 222 333"), normalisePhone("+387 66 444 555") ], absent: [ normalisePhone(null), normalisePhone(" "), normalisePhone(" - ( ) ") ] }

munit:test.name: age-respects-birthday-and-leap-day-boundaries
munit:test.description: Completed years: birthday reached on the day itself; 29 February counts from 1 March in non-leap years

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import ageOn from dwl::RegistrationRules output application/json --- { dayBeforeBirthday: ageOn(|2008-10-16|, |2026-10-15|), onBirthday: ageOn(|2008-10-15|, |2026-10-15|), dayAfterBirthday: ageOn(|2008-10-14|, |2026-10-15|), bornToday: ageOn(|2026-10-15|, |2026-10-15|), leapDayOnFeb28: ageOn(|2008-02-29|, |2026-02-28|), leapDayOnMar01: ageOn(|2008-02-29|, |2026-03-01|), leapDayInLeapYear: ageOn(|2008-02-29|, |2028-02-29|), case1Ana: ageOn(|1985-04-12|, |2026-10-15|) }

munit:test.name: category-boundaries-are-18-and-65
munit:test.description: Under 18 MINOR, 18 to 64 ADULT, 65 and over SENIOR

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import categoryFor from dwl::RegistrationRules output application/json --- [0, 17, 18, 64, 65, 101] map categoryFor($)

munit:test.name: business-rules-birth-date-and-consent
munit:test.description: Today is allowed, tomorrow is in the future; only consent true counts

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import isBornInFuture, hasDataProcessingConsent from dwl::RegistrationRules output application/json --- { today: isBornInFuture("2026-10-15", |2026-10-15|), tomorrow: isBornInFuture("2026-10-16", |2026-10-15|), yesterday: isBornInFuture("2026-10-14", |2026-10-15|), consentTrue: hasDataProcessingConsent({ consents: { dataProcessing: true } }), consentFalse: hasDataProcessingConsent({ consents: { dataProcessing: false } }) }

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[{ today: false, tomorrow: true, yesterday: false, consentTrue: true, consentFalse: false }]

munit:test.name: today-follows-the-clinic-time-zone
munit:test.description: todayIn returns the calendar date of the given zone, which can differ from UTC around midnight

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import todayIn from dwl::RegistrationRules output application/json --- { sarajevo: todayIn("Europe/Sarajevo") == ((now() >> "Europe/Sarajevo") as Date), isDate: todayIn("UTC") is Date }

munit:test.name: downstream-responses-keep-their-meaning
munit:test.description: Known 4xx codes propagate; unknown bodies, 5xx and odd statuses become DOWNSTREAM_ERROR; 2xx is not an error

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import errorCodeFor from dwl::Downstream output application/json fun body(code) = { error: { code: code, message: "m", correlationId: "c", timestamp: "t" } } --- { created: errorCodeFor(201, {}), ok: errorCodeFor(200, {}), notFound: errorCodeFor(404, body("PATIENT_NOT_FOUND")), duplicate: errorCodeFor(409, body("DUPLICATE_PATIENT")), birthDate: errorCodeFor(422, body("INVALID_BIRTH_DATE")), consent: errorCodeFor(422, body("CONSENT_REQUIRED")), badRequest: errorCodeFor(400, body("BAD_REQUEST")), route404: errorCodeFor(404, body("RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND")), html503: errorCodeFor(503, "<html>down</html>"), text404: errorCodeFor(404, "Not Found"), server500: errorCodeFor(500, body("INTERNAL_ERROR")), mismatched: errorCodeFor(409, body("PATIENT_NOT_FOUND")), unauth: errorCodeFor(401, null) }

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[{ created: null, ok: null, notFound: 'PATIENT_NOT_FOUND', duplicate: 'DUPLICATE_PATIENT', birthDate: 'INVALID_BIRTH_DATE', consent: 'CONSENT_REQUIRED', badRequest: 'BAD_REQUEST', route404: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', html503: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', text404: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', server500: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', mismatched: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', unauth: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR' } orderBy $$]

munit:test.name: api-errors-maps-http-and-retry-errors-to-downstream-error
munit:test.description: Connectivity, timeout, 503 and exhausted retries all answer 502 DOWNSTREAM_ERROR

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import codeFor, statusFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json --- [ { namespace: "HTTP", identifier: "CONNECTIVITY" }, { namespace: "HTTP", identifier: "TIMEOUT" }, { namespace: "HTTP", identifier: "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE" }, { namespace: "MULE", identifier: "RETRY_EXHAUSTED" }, { namespace: "APP", identifier: "INVALID_BIRTH_DATE" }, { namespace: "APP", identifier: "CONSENT_REQUIRED" } ] map { code: codeFor($), status: statusFor(codeFor($)) }

munit-tools:assert-equals.expected: #[[ { code: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', status: 502 }, { code: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', status: 502 }, { code: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', status: 502 }, { code: 'DOWNSTREAM_ERROR', status: 502 }, { code: 'INVALID_BIRTH_DATE', status: 422 }, { code: 'CONSENT_REQUIRED', status: 422 } ]]

munit:test.name: log-event-is-a-single-line-json-object
munit:test.description: LogEvent.event: event name and correlation ID first, then the fields, on one line

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import event, elapsedMillis from dwl::LogEvent output application/json var message = event("response.sent", "cid-1", { status: 201, path: "/api/patients" }) --- { message: message, parsed: read(message, "application/json"), oneLine: not (message contains "\n"), elapsedIsNonNegative: elapsedMillis(now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" }) >= 0 }
